title: Comptime Fibonacci
description: Write a Zig program that computes Fibonacci numbers at compile time using comptime evaluation.
hints: Use `comptime` keyword to force compile-time evaluation
The `comptime` parameter in `fn fibonacci(comptime n: u32)` forces all calls to be evaluated at compile time
Comptime evaluation has no runtime overhead — the result is inlined as a constant
